How to make a claim. 1. An itemised receipt from the provider, showing the treatment, the date and the amount. A referral, if the treatment needs one: - consultant visits need a referral from your GP; - physiotherapy needs a referral from a GP or consultant. 3. A pre-authorisation number, for a day case procedure or an inpatient stay.
